title: Tech Note: Enhanced User Environment Wizards

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates the enhanced V6 User Environment wizards (Quick Report, Label, Query, Order by..., and Charting Wizards) using the MyMusic tutorial database; while the underlying goal of wizard-assisted end-user querying/reporting remains relevant, these specific classic User Mode wizards and the MyMusic tutorial database itself belong to a design-mode-only era that has been substantially reworked in look, feel, and capability across later 4D versions.
related_updates: 4D's User Mode wizards (Quick Report, Label, Query, Order by..., Charting) have been substantially redesigned and re-capabilitized across many subsequent 4D versions since v6
The MyMusic tutorial database referenced here is a period-specific 4D v6 sample application, not necessarily carried forward as-is in modern 4D installations
